name: PMatter
description: Matter node server. Connects to a python-matter-server instance over its websocket API, discovers paired Matter devices, and creates ISY nodes for each on/off endpoint.
notice: Enter the IP address of your python-matter-server instance. The port defaults to 5580 and can be changed if needed.

credits.title: PMatter: a NodeServer for python-matter-server Integration
credits.author: Andy Wysocki
